summary: Ziit is a self-hosted alternative to WakaTime that tracks how you spend your time writing code. It aggregates metrics on your programming activity directly from your development environment.
goodFor: Developers who want a self-hosted tool to track their programming hours and language usage without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: With a low maintenance health score and slowing development, you may encounter unpatched bugs or need to maintain the codebase yourself. It also faces strong competition from more established tracking solutions.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
